about_the_game:
Type, grow, and decorate – let your plants thrive while you work.

Every keystroke helps a little plant grow! Whether you're writing, coding, or just chatting, this peaceful desktop overlay brings a touch of green to your everyday routine.

Start with a tiny sprout that grows as you type. When your screen gets crowded, move your plants to a foldable plant shelf, where they continue growing quietly in the background. Over time, you'll discover a variety of plant types!

Decorate your desktop with your favorite green companions and build your own little digital garden.

And if you're the productive type, track how much you've typed with a gentle growth-based progress system – watch your focus bloom alongside your plants.

Features:

  • Plants grow with every keystroke

  • Move grown plants into a collapsible shelf to clear your screen

  • Discover a variety of plants

  • Keep growing plants even when they're in storage

  • Decorate your desktop with your favorite green friends

  • Track your typing activity through plant growth

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd Gen or newer) or equivalent AMD processor
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better)

short_description: Type and watch your garden grow! Every keystroke and mouse click helps your little plant thrive. Whether you're working, gaming, or just vibing, your leafy buddy grows alongside you. Can you collect them all?
